title: 第五十章 焚道碎天地，血镜启轮回
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

五重天罚尽数溃败，天道威严扫地，始祖彻底失去所有耐心。

他不再循序渐进、不再试探消磨，直接引爆第六重终极杀劫！

漫天云层瞬间化作赤红火海，熊熊天道焚火贯穿虚空，灼热的毁灭气息碾压万古，连周遭的时空都被烧得扭曲褶皱。

第六重——焚道天劫！

此劫，焚圣脉、焚龙气、焚人道、焚圣道，焚烧一切逆道本源，磨灭所有超脱天道的异数！

烈火焚天，道基尽毁，是足以焚烧一方天地的终极浩劫！

滚滚焚天火海轰然坠落，穿透虚空，直压万世护生大阵！

轰隆——！

大阵剧烈震颤，表层灵光飞速灼烧黯淡，无数灵纹被天道焚火点燃、寸寸碎裂。

护生大阵乃二人本源所化，大阵受损，两人同时心口剧痛，气血翻涌，嘴角齐齐渗出血色。

“大阵快撑不住了！”沈清鸢眸光凝重。

本源透支、五重劫力缠身，再遇焚道天火，他们的护体道基已然濒临极限。

始祖居高临下，狞笑着俯瞰狼狈二人：

“我看你们还怎么护苍生！怎么守羁绊！”

“焚道天火专克你人圣双道！今日烧碎你们的道基，焚尽你们的本源！”

漫天火海层层碾压，即将彻底撕裂护生大阵、倾覆人间盛世！

千钧一发之际，萧聿辞骤然抬眸，眼底金龙万丈爆发！

“鸢儿，最后一次，全力合功！”

“好！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The five levels of heavenly punishment were all defeated, the majesty of heavenly law was wiped out, and the ancestors completely lost all patience.

He no longer proceeds step by step, no longer tests and wastes time, and directly detonates the sixth level of ultimate murder!

The clouds all over the sky instantly turned into a sea of ​​crimson fire, and the blazing fire of heaven penetrated the void. The scorching aura of destruction crushed the eternity, and even the surrounding time and space were burned into distortions and folds.

The sixth level - Burning Dao Heavenly Tribulation!

In this calamity, burn the holy veins, burn the dragon energy, burn the human way, burn the holy way, burn the origin of all contrary ways, and destroy all the anomalies that transcend the heavenly way!

Fierce fire burns the sky and destroys all the foundations of the Dao. It is the ultimate catastrophe that can burn down a whole world!

The rolling sky-burning sea of ​​fire crashed down, penetrated the void, and directly pressed against the eternal life-protecting formation!

Boom——!

The formation trembled violently, the spiritual light on the surface quickly burned and dimmed, and countless spiritual patterns were ignited by the fire of heaven and shattered inch by inch.

The formation for protecting students was formed from the origins of the two of them. When the formation was damaged, both of them felt severe pain in their hearts at the same time, their energy and blood surged, and blood oozed from the corners of their mouths.

"The formation can no longer hold up!" Shen Qingyuan's eyes were solemn.

Their origins were overdrawn, entangled with five levels of calamity, and when they encountered the Burning Heavenly Fire again, their body-protecting foundation was already on the verge of reaching its limit.

The ancestor stood down from a high place, looking down at the embarrassed two people with a ferocious smile:

"I see how you can protect the common people! How can you keep your bonds!"

"The Burning Dao and Heavenly Fire are designed to conquer your human and holy paths! Today, your Dao foundation will be burned to pieces and your origins will be burned away!"

The sky is filled with fire and the sea is crushing layer by layer, and is about to completely tear apart the life-protecting formation and overturn the prosperous world of the world!

At the critical moment, Xiao Yuci suddenly raised his eyes, and golden dragons erupted in his eyes!

"Yuan'er, for the last time, work together with all your strength!"

"Okay!"
